subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to 100 words.
guide_solution: A high educated woman Pirtilata was inspired by the spirit of independence. She involved herself in terrorist movement. On a mission to attack Pahartali European Club she succeeded but could not escape. She committed suicide. Her suicide proved that women could equally sacrifice themselves like men of the cause of liberty. She held her name high among the Bangalee women.
